# T & T Nail Salon

> Nail art & nail salon on East 3rd St based in Bloomington, Indiana. Acrylic sets, gel, cat eye, pedicures and hand-painted art on East 3rd Street. Bring your inspo pic and leave with a set you'll keep showing off.

- Phone: (812) 822-1980
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Bedford, Spencer, Martinsville
- Google rating: 4.4 from 208 reviews

## Services
- Acrylic full sets: Long or short, coffin, almond or stiletto, shaped the way you want them.
- Gel polish: Glossy color that holds up through class, work and everything in between.
- Cat eye & chrome: The magnetic shimmer clients call the best cat eye in Bloomington, plus chrome finishes.
- Nail art: Swirls, butterflies, ombre and hand-painted details. Bring a picture or let us get creative.
- Seasonal sets: Fall leaves, Halloween webs, winter snowflakes and holiday sparkle.
- Pedicures: Sit back in a massage chair after a long week on your feet and leave with fresh toes.

## About
T & T Nail Salon sits at 2654 East 3rd Street in Bloomington, under the red T&T Nails sign, a short drive from the IU campus. It's a busy, friendly shop where students and long-time locals sit side by side at the marble tables. Clients come for the art: cat eye that regulars call the best in Bloomington, chrome and holographic finishes, long coffin and stiletto sets, rainbow ombre, 3D flowers, butterflies and seasonal designs that change with the calendar. Bring a picture and we'll take the time to get it exactly right, even if that means trying a few finishes first. Some clients have been coming since their freshman year. Walk in any day of the week, or call ahead to save a chair for a detailed set.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome any day we're open, and we'll fit you in as soon as a chair opens. Weekends get busy, so calling (812) 822-1980 ahead saves you a wait.
- Q: Should I book ahead for nail art?
  A: For a detailed design, a full set with art or a specific time, call ahead so we can set aside the time to get it exactly right.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 9:30 am to 7 pm, and Sunday 11 am to 5 pm.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 2654 E 3rd St, Bloomington, IN 47401. Look for the red T&T Nails sign on East 3rd Street, a short drive from the IU campus.
- Q: Can I bring an inspiration photo?
  A: Please do. Show us the picture and we'll talk through shape, length and colors before we start.
- Q: Do you do cat eye and chrome?
  A: Yes. Cat eye is one of our most-requested looks, along with mirror, rose gold and holographic chrome and seasonal art.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Call (812) 822-1980, use the form on this site, or just walk in.
